text: ふむ…　おしえテレビを　みる　じかんも　ないとは…　タイム　イズ　マネー…　…　ときは　かねなりか
note: He first says the English proverb in katakana (タイム イズ マネー), then repeats it in its set Japanese form, ときはかねなり (時は金なり).
claim: 時は金なり (toki wa kane nari) is the standard Japanese rendering of the proverb "Time is money".
